Here you can really recharge your batteries. The house has 4 half-floors, which helps to create a good atmosphere. The large windows create proximity to nature and the mountains. You can look out for hours without getting tired of the view, while enjoying a book. The house has its own backyard with seating furniture and access to a gas grill. You can enjoy your morning coffee in the backyard or in the afternoon on the front side and enjoy the view until the sun goes down behind the mountains. Child-friendly. We have a trampoline with safety net. Central location!

Guest access
The whole house.

Other things to note
I have worked in the tourism industry before and have good knowledge of Lofoten. 

There is a short distance to the football and tennis court, 700 meters to walk. 

I recommend renting a car to get around as there is a lot to see outside the city center as well. This is to maximize the experience of Lofoten. 

It is possible to fish from the bridge just below the house.

There are many outdoor activities to do within walking distance. Just ask me as a host and I will help you with my best tips based on your needs and desires.

We loved our stay at Anne’s place! The HUGE living room window with incredible mountain/water view was easily one of our favorite parts. We spent so much time just sitting there taking it all in. The house itself is cozy, comfortable, and has a great layout, including a downstairs bedroom and bathroom that offer a little extra privacy.
The kitchen is extremely well stocked, which made it really easy to cook and feel at home. The location was also fantastic. There’s plenty to do and explore in the surrounding area, and we loved being able to walk to restaurants and coffee while still being just a short drive from groceries, gas, and anything else we needed.
Anne was incredibly responsive, kind, and helpful throughout our stay. This was a wonderful home base for exploring East Lofoten, and we would absolutely stay here again!

Where you’ll be
Vågan, Nordland, Norway
Quiet and peaceful neighborhood, walking distance to all amenities in Svolvær. Fixing opportunity below the house by the bridge. 1 km to the town centre. Soccer field 700 meters to walk. It is 2 kilometers to the public beach. 2 km to popular swimming area by the king's water.

I'm an outgoing and happy lady. I love my home. I have 3 children aged 10, 17 and 21. I enjoy being outdoors the most, whether it's running or spending time in the mountains. It is therefore a privilege to have hiking terrain in the immediate vicinity. Put on your shoes and stroll to the nearest mountain. 6 peaks are in walking distance. This is the third season I share the idyll of staying in such a spectacular place! Looking forward to sharing my love for Lofoten and my home with you. <3
